body:
Follow-up to `ambient-dscorr` (its first "Next step"): hard-message dependence between the two auditors, plain vs hardness-aware Dawid-Skene.

- Plain DS costs much less than under copying; it falls to the naive estimator only in an extreme cell, never below it.
- Hardness-aware EM recovers the classifier and policy utility, but the hard share is not identified (three starts, same fit).
- 7 tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints `ok`. Stylised, simulated results only.
- Closed #579 as a duplicate of the already-landed `ambient-dscorr`.
